title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode3 At the Very Least

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Come on, Ichi!
Let's go find Hona and Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-It's just that...lunch break is too short to go over for a chat! We wouldn't have time to eat our lunch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can talk while eating. Come on, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I should explain the situation to her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (On the other hand, Saki being back might change things between Honami, Shiho, and me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki?! What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee! Surprised to see me? I've been discharged from the hospital and, from today, I'm back at school!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona! It's been ages! I just came back to school from today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I didn't know you were coming back!
That's really great news.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I, um... I have to go now. Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My next lesson's in a different classroom, so I've got to go now too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's the hurry? I thought we could have lunch together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I... I already promised a friend I'd meet her for lunch.
You take care, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, but... Gosh, she seemed in a real rush.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They're probably just really busy.
It gets like this in high school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lot of things are... different now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess so... Everyone wants to get the most out of their high school life.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's what I should be doing as well! You only live once!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Did you hear? The class next door got a new student today.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Ah, yeah, that girl with dyed hair. Didn't you talk to her at lunch break, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes. We used to go to the same school.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: So you already knew her. I heard she was ill and just recovered enough to come back to school?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's right. I didn't know she was coming back today.
It was something of a shock for me to see her.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: It was nice of her to remember you and come say hi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... She's very kind, and always cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, are you going home now, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Uh... No, I was just asking.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: She's kind of cold and unapproachable.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah. I find her kind of difficult to talk to too.
I heard she's in a band, so I'm guessing that thing she was carrying was a guitar?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Apparently, she's always been like this.
A girl who was in the same class as her in junior high told me.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line:
She gets hostile when anyone tries to make
friends with her.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Really? Maybe she prefers to be alone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I was thinking of going to the bookstore on the way home.
Want to come with me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great! Oh, and by the way...
